note: The promotions page https://www.ocbc.com.my/personal-banking/promotion loads its tiles from these two public JSON files. Each item of visiblePromo is one tile; the offer is the popup (FreeText and terms) at https://www.ocbc.com.my/personal-banking/promotion#<id>. date.start and date.end are the listing window of the tile, not the offer period: take the offer dates from the 'Promotion period' line of the popup text (NEXT_CRAWLS section 3.1). Items whose listing window has ended are expired and are not handed in.
